Hi everyone,

Text before the first `##` heading is the intro: a short note from the
editors. Use *italics*, **bold** and [links](https://example.org).

The editorial team

## Featured story

::: {.feature image="images/feature.png" alt="Placeholder image" link="https://example.org" cap="A caption describes the image" credits="Photographer name"}
### A featured story with an image

The image is clickable when the block has `link="..."`, and `cap=` and
`credits=` add a small caption under it.

[Read the story](https://example.org){.button}
:::

## Image beside text

::: {.wrap image="images/card-1.png" alt="Placeholder image" side="right" cap="A caption under the image"}
#### Text flows around the image

Write a paragraph or more beside an image placed with `side="right"` or
`side="left"`. The text runs down beside the image and continues full width
underneath it. On phones, the image moves above the text instead. Use
`width="..."` to make the image larger or smaller; it's 200 pixels wide by
default.
:::

## Upcoming events {.tinted}

This section is shaded: its heading is written `## Upcoming events {.tinted}`.

::: {.event date="2026-12-10" time="10:00 to 11:30 a.m." place="Online"}
### An event with a date, time and place

Write the date as YYYY-MM-DD and the weekday is filled in for you.

[Register](https://example.org){.button .secondary}
:::
